nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership / acceptOwnership).
Public ERC20 token symbol string initialized to 'SMARTs'.
Public ERC20 token name string initialized to 'SmartCoin'.
Public token decimals value, set to 18 in the constructor.
Internal fixed total supply minted in the constructor (786000000000 * 10**18).
Mapping of holder address to token balance; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount, written by approve/approveAndCall and read by transferFrom/allowance.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
SmartCoin constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and balances[owner], emitting Transfer.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Finalizes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then resets newOwner.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath sub.
View returning the token balance of tokenOwner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance: debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to], emits Transfer.
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval before returning.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external call to an arbitrary token contract to rescue tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowance keys.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state writes.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied contract address.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the proposed new owner address.
Parameter of balanceOf identifying the account whose balance is queried.
Parameter of approve identifying the account granted an allowance.
Recipient address parameter appearing in transfer/transferFrom.
Token amount parameter used in transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Debit source address parameter of transferFrom.
User-supplied ERC20 contract address passed to transferAnyERC20Token.
Opaque calldata forwarded to the spender contract in approveAndCall.
Boolean success return value of transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall/transferAnyERC20Token.
Named return value 'balance' of balanceOf.
Named return value 'remaining' of allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the Owned constructor, seeding all later authorization checks.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender with owner.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable to authorize the call.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before taking ownership.
newOwner is compared with msg.sender and then written into owner, completing the transfer.
msg.sender is the debit source for the token transfer.
balances is read and updated with SafeMath sub for the sender and add for the recipient.
Arithmetic results are written back into the balances mapping.
The allowance is keyed by msg.sender, preventing approval of other accounts.
approve writes the allowed mapping for (msg.sender, spender).
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], consuming the caller's allowance.
balances[from] and balances[to] are updated with SafeMath sub/add.
The allowance mapping is decremented before the balance credit.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
The allowed mapping is mutated prior to invoking the untrusted spender contract.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an attacker-controlled contract.
The untrusted callee runs while allowance state is already set, enabling state manipulation on re-entry.
receiveApproval is a callback that can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner to msg.sender == owner.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary user-supplied contract address.
The target token contract can call back into the token while the rescue call is executing.
A malicious token contract invoked via the external call can re-enter and read/modify balances.
The SmartCoin constructor assigns the fixed total supply.
The constructor mints the entire supply to balances[owner].
The constructor uses the owner address as the initial token holder.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested holder.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply using SafeMath.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the burn-adjusted supply input.
The fallback reverts for any caller attempting to send ETH.
_newOwner is assigned into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner is used as the lookup key in balances.
spender is used as the inner key of the allowed mapping.
The recipient address 'to' receives the credited balance.
The tokens amount feeds the SafeMath sub/add balance arithmetic.
from is the debited account in transferFrom.
tokenAddress is the untrusted contract invoked through ERC20Interface.
data bytes are forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The success boolean is the returned result of the transfer operation.
The named return 'balance' carries the queried balance out of balanceOf.
The named return 'remaining' carries the allowance out of allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is a parameter that exists only to populate the newOwner state via transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is a read-only lookup parameter of the balanceOf view function.
spender is a parameter used solely as the allowance key in approve.
The recipient 'to' parameter only feeds the balance credit in transfer.
The tokens amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath balance arithmetic in transfer.
The 'from' parameter only selects the debited account in transferFrom.
tokenAddress only selects the external contract target in transferAnyERC20Token.
data only exists to be forwarded to the external call in approveAndCall.
The success return flag can be folded into the transfer function it reports on.
The named return balance is a transient value of balanceOf.
The named return remaining is a transient value of allowance.
